subject: ISO + FedRAMP readiness: playbook questions and sprint prioritization
messages:
From: Lisa Cho <lisa@triggersecurity.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Initial intake: ISO 27001 scoping & FedRAMP pre-audit

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick intake form. A couple of clarifying questions as we scope the FedRAMP readiness check and ISO 27001 alignment for Acme Financial Services:

1) Boundary: can you confirm whether the private deployment option for Acme (VPC-only) is in-scope for both FedRAMP and ISO artifacts, or should we treat it as an isolated on-prem customer (separate evidence set)?

2) ISMS artifacts: please confirm where the current ISMS policy, risk register, and Statement of Applicability live (link or drive location preferred).

3) KMS & key lifecycle: we will need key rotation proof, KMS access control lists, and audit logs (at least 6 months) for FedRAMP baseline. Is KMS single-tenant for the dedicated/vpc offering?

4) Change control & deployment evidence: ask for a recent example of a code promotion/change control ticket that includes approvals and rollback notes — ideally from the last 90 days.

5) Sampling window: recommend 30-day evidence window for initial intake; will you accept alternate windows?

We can take this quick in a 30-minute call if helpful. Attaching a short intake checklist — feel free to forward to control owners.

Attachment: initial_intake_form.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Lisa Cho
Senior Auditor, Trigger Security

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial intake: ISO 27001 scoping & FedRAMP pre-audit

Thanks Lisa — copying Karthik, Marissa, and Olga to confirm owners and a delivery plan.

Answers / proposed approach:
- Boundary: treat Acme's VPC deployment as in-scope for FedRAMP artifacts (they are requesting attestation for the VPC-delivered offering). For ISO 27001, we can map a subset of controls to the private deployment; we'll call out the difference in the evidence index.
- ISMS artifacts: primary ISMS documents are in the Compliance drive (see link below). Marissa will confirm exact SoA version.
- KMS: Karthik — can you confirm tenancy model for Acme's keys and provide last 6 months of rotation/audit logs? If single-tenant, note that in the evidence column.
- Change control: Olga — please pull one recent production deployment ticket that includes approvals and rollback steps (ideally from last 90 days).
- Sampling window: proposal — start with 30 days for the initial intake, but keep the option to expand to 90 days if auditors need it.

Next steps:
1) Owners (below) confirm by EOD Monday 2027-04-05.
2) I will schedule a 30-minute intake call with Lisa for Tue 2027-04-06.
3) Marissa will upload a preliminary evidence index (sheet) to the drive and share link.

Attachment: evidence_tracker.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

> Thanks Lisa — copying Karthik, Marissa, and Olga to confirm owners and a delivery plan.

Agree with the plan. Quick prioritization from a compliance intake perspective:

1) Evidence index + SoA version — target: Mon 2027-04-05 COB (owner: Marissa). I will include a mapping column for SOC 2 and CAIQ so we can drive a single evidence pull where possible.
2) KMS rotation & logs — target: Tue 2027-04-06 EOD (owner: Karthik). Note: if keys are customer-managed in the VPC option we'll flag that as customer scope and supply only the platform-side controls.
3) Change control artifact — target: Tue 2027-04-06 COB (owner: Olga).
4) Deployment topology diagram + network segmentation notes — target: Wed 2027-04-07 (owner: Infrastructure doc team; Olga to coordinate).

I'll attach a first-pass controls mapping CSV (controls_mapping_v1.csv) to the drive and reference it in the evidence tracker. We should run the CAIQ and SIG in parallel to avoid duplicated asks.

-Marissa

Subject: Re: Initial intake: ISO 27001 scoping & FedRAMP pre-audit

Hi all — looping in the technical answers Lisa asked for and confirming links. Forwarding to AuditOps for visibility.

- KMS tenancy: the Acme VPC offering uses a customer master key in a customer-managed key ring for encryption-at-rest; platform manages envelope keys. I'll export the key rotation audit log for the last 6 months and push to the evidence drive.
- Rotation proof: rotation events are in the rotate_kms_events table (we will extract CSV).
- Audit logs: centralized audit logs are retained 12 months; a secure extract for the 30-day sampling window will be created as a read-only snapshot.
- Change control example: see JIRA SUP-4321 — recent hotfix promotion includes approvals, rollback notes, and postmortem link.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_evidence_folder
Jira: JIRA-SUP-4321

If AuditOps needs a signed attestation about tenancy boundaries, I can draft a short statement and add it to the evidence tracker.

-Karthik
Head of Infrastructure
